other_continuous_flow_signals.signal: Cogeneration of electricity from sugar cane bagasse presented as a continuous industrial power activity; sugar mills operate cogeneration plants
other_continuous_flow_signals.quote:
the country has great potential to develop a cogeneration industry 
based on sugar cane bagasse.

other_continuous_flow_signals.signal: Sugar mills identified as cogeneration plants in Colombia (11 of 21), with installed capacity growing
other_continuous_flow_signals.quote:
of the 21 cogeneration plants existing in Colombia, 11 correspond to sugar mills: Risaralda, Riopaila, San Carlos, Providencia, Manuelita, La Cabaña, Castilla, María Luisa, 
Mayagüez, Incauca and Bioenergy.

other_continuous_flow_signals.signal: Empirical Sankey analysis of the cogeneration process at Ingenio del Cauca, distributing electrical power to milling, substation and factory processes
other_continuous_flow_signals.quote:
Figure 5 shows the Sankey diagram for part of the cogeneration process at Ingenio 
del Cauca. From the consumption data at the different points of the factory, it can be 
seen that the milling process demands 30% of the electrical power generated (840 
kW) by cogeneration

other_continuous_flow_signals.signal: Sugar milling described with continuous plant operation, startup/shutdown lags between milling and cogeneration/manufacturing/services
other_continuous_flow_signals.quote:
the mills have a lag 
of about 8 hours in start-ups and shutdowns between the cane milling process and the 
rest of the plant (cogeneration, manufacturing, and services)

one_line: The paper empirically applies ISO 50001 energy-management tools to characterize electrical energy use and estimate savings potential at a Colombian sugar mill (Ingenio del Cauca), a sugar-production/agroindustrial context that includes bagasse cogeneration but is not among the eight registered Corpus B sectors.
